hours.notes: No to-go orders during peak hours: 11:30am-2:00pm (lunch) and 6:30pm-8:30pm (dinner). Party size limited to 8 or less during peak hours.

about.description: The Sloop Galley and Spirits began as an idea from two local restauranteurs with over 40 years of restaurant experience. The location and timing came together in the summer of 2019. The Sloop prides itself on fresh quality foods made in house and exceptional service. One of the partners, James Gallen, from the Philadelphia area decided to incorporate original Philly cheesesteaks on the menus as they are not offered in the south. The other partner, BR Mock, decorated the establishment with authentic sailing tools, pictures, and memorabilia from his days sailing. The Sloop is a locals eatery and watering hole. We do welcome families and children but please remember that we are a sports bar with great homemade items. We do enjoy our island visitors as well! Due to our size limitation we can only handle seating of 8 or less during peak hours.
about.elevator_pitch: Gulf Shores' saltiest pirate-themed dive bar serving authentic Philly cheesesteaks, house-brined wings, and fresh homemade food alongside live music and every sports package you could want.
about.vibe: Salty pirate dive bar with nautical charm and energy
about.reservations: No reservations. Seating is first come, first serve.
about.insider_tip: Order the famous cheesesteak on an authentic J.J. Cassone roll or try it stuffed in egg rolls — a Philly tradition rarely found in the South. Check Facebook for daily specials.
